description: The versioned, deterministic, pure rules of the matching fabric: maxCandidates (the result cap), includePartialMatches (partial candidates appear WITH explicit unmatched reasons) and availabilityRequired (fail closed on availability conflicts). The RANKING is fixed and deterministic — fully-satisfying candidates first, then satisfied-count descending, then evidence depth descending, then tie-break by content digest — with NO aggregate quality score and NO reputation input anywhere (spec/quality-model.md).
